2] This is the first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.89/2023 registered at Police Station- Chimanganj Mandi, Ujjain (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 368, 376(2)(N), 363, 376(2)(k), 376(2)(h) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 5(L), 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
The applicant is in custody since 27.5.2024.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.
4 ] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the charge sheet has already been filed and the prosecutrix was a consenting party and she had gone with the applicant with her own volition.
It is also submitted that the applicant is in jail since 27.5.2024 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a long time.
Thus, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

2 MCRC-28794-2024 6] On due consideration of the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case diary as also taking note of the fact that the prosecutrix is a consenting party , this Court finds it expedient to allow the bail application.
Accordingly, without commenting upon the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7 ] The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also Vijay @ Nana vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114706259/
